text:
Maria G: Hey team, final draft is attached. Need quick confirmations for: 1) headline lock, 2) benchmark wording, 3) webinar CTA and lead routing. I edited the intro to lead with the customer problem. Link: doc.google/example.

Josh P: Headline suggestion: 'Predictable inference, predictable product velocity.' feels snappier. For benchmarks, prefer absolute medians + percentiles instead of vague multipliers. e.g., median gen 240ms (p95 520ms) at 1k tokens — works?

Samuel K: That headline reads nice. Suggest the 2nd paragraph call out 'production economics' explicitly. Also can we add one sentence contrasting hosted vs dedicated for compliance? Short, not a full section.

Emily L: Legal: please remove the phrase about 'complete data isolation by default'. Replace with 'data isolation available via dedicated deployments and VPC options' and include a link to the compliance page. Also need a traceable eval artifact attached before publish.

Maria G: will change residency language to Emily's phrasing and add link. Josh's median/p95 numbers sound good — I'll insert them into the benchmark callout box.

Alex R: quote ready: 'We built Redwood so teams don't have to trade reliability for speed.' Use it as the CTO quote.

Maria G: thanks Alex. Anyone want to verbatim-edit the CTA/landing copy for the webinar sign-up? I drafted: 'Join our launch webinar to see a live demo and get the eval report.' Thoughts?

Anna O: That CTA is fine. Ops notes: scheduling the webinar and publish the same day increases signups. Recommend publish 10am PST and webinar 48 hours later to give partners time. I can create HubSpot form with hidden fields: source=product_launch, campaign=2026_launch.

Josh P: agree with the stagger: publish on Tuesday 10am PST, webinar Thursday 11am PST. Also add checkbox on the form to request the detailed eval.

Maria G: inbound mapping: HubSpot list name '2026_Product_Launch', tags: 'source:blog', 'interest:benchmark'. Add a boolean field 'wants_eval'. Anna, can you create the workflow that sends the eval to anyone who checks that box?

Anna O: Will do. Workflow: on form submission, if wants_eval=true, add to 'Eval_Deliver' sequence + send S3 link via email. I'll share test link by EOD.

Emily L: legal approves revised residency copy and Alex's quote. Still need the eval artifact uploaded to the company audit drive before we hit publish.

Samuel K: product approves the benchmark wording with Josh's numbers. Also small nit: in the hero image alt text, include 'Redwood Inference platform'.

Maria G: noted. I'll upload the eval, update hero alt, and request CMS publish. If everyone signs off I'll ask publish-bot to schedule. Final signers: Josh (product), Emily (legal), Anna (ops).

Josh P: sign-off from product.

Emily L: legal sign-off final. artifact requirement noted.

Anna O: ops confirmed mapping + webinar schedule. test form will be in the thread.

Maria G: great — please stand by for doc update. @publish-bot can you schedule CMS publish for 2026-04-07T10:00:00-08:00 and create webhook to HubSpot form?

publish-bot: Scheduled: Post "Predictable inference, predictable product velocity" set to publish 2026-04-07 10:00 PST. HubSpot form webhook configured.

Maria G: thanks everyone — final checklist: eval uploaded, hero alt updated, HubSpot form live, workflow sends eval on request. If no further comments I will press publish on Tuesday. :rocket:
